claims.statement: The Prime Minister offers Scotland a model of localised employment support, similar to England's, shaped by Holyrood.

claims.quote: I want to work with the First Minister to deliver it.
claims.statement: The Prime Minister wants to work with the First Minister to deliver good growth in every postcode.

claims.quote: And I won’t have a country where we get comfortable with the idea of kids in their 20s just being there on benefits.
claims.statement: The Prime Minister will not accept a country where young people in their 20s are left on benefits.

claims.quote: Instead, we’ve ended up with the situation where Scotland, the most devolved nation in the UK, is itself one of the most centralised nations in Europe.
claims.statement: Scotland, the most devolved nation in the UK, is one of the most centralised nations in Europe.

claims.quote: And if we don’t move now, Scotland could lose out.
claims.statement: Scotland could lose out if the devolution of power does not move quickly.

claims.quote: I want all public procurement in the UK to work like that
claims.statement: The Prime Minister wants all UK public procurement to back British manufacturing as Greater Manchester's bus contracts did.

claims.quote: And I want to explore now how Scotland’s regions can have the same powers to decide where more of that research and development investment goes.
claims.statement: The Prime Minister wants to explore giving Scotland's regions power over research and development investment.

claims.quote: And the fact is around one in six young people here are not in education, employment or training.
claims.statement: Around one in six young people in Scotland are not in education, employment or training.

claims.quote: If you go to Edinburgh today, you’ll see around one in twenty shops lying empty.
claims.statement: Around one in twenty shops in Edinburgh are empty, against around one in five in Dundee.

claims.quote: A man in East Renfrewshire can live, as I understand, on average seven years longer than a man in Glasgow
claims.statement: A man in East Renfrewshire can live on average around seven years longer than a man in Glasgow.

claims.quote: In Dundee, you’ve got a world-leading video games industry.
claims.statement: Dundee has a world-leading video games industry.

claims.quote: An approach that puts local businesses, universities and councils in the driving seat has seen companies like Chemify turn groundbreaking research into real manufacturing jobs in Glasgow.
claims.statement: Chemify has turned groundbreaking research into real manufacturing jobs in Glasgow.

claims.quote: And in the immediate months ahead, I want us to design a new model, together, of regional economic empowerment across all of Scotland.
claims.statement: The Prime Minister wants the two governments to design a new model of regional economic empowerment across Scotland in the months ahead.

facts.quote: In August 2023, with the help of the ground-breaking Scottish Violence Reduction Unit, I visited FARE-Scotland at Bannatyne House in Easterhouse with the Greater Manchester Violence Reduction Unit.
facts.statement: The Prime Minister visited FARE-Scotland at Bannatyne House in Easterhouse in August 2023 with the Greater Manchester Violence Reduction Unit.

facts.quote: I left Westminster in 2017 to become the first Mayor of Greater Manchester
facts.statement: The Prime Minister left Westminster in 2017 to become the first Mayor of Greater Manchester.

facts.quote: I used it to pioneer what we called the Live Well model in Greater Manchester.
facts.statement: The Prime Minister pioneered the Live Well model in Greater Manchester after visiting Easterhouse.

facts.quote: So I was determined that the buses on the roads of Greater Manchester today were built by Alexander Dennis in Falkirk.
facts.statement: Greater Manchester's buses were built by Alexander Dennis in Falkirk after the Prime Minister chose Scottish manufacturing as Mayor.

facts.quote: It is great that the Scottish government has this week agreed to match the UK government’s £10 million to create two defence technical excellence colleges
facts.statement: The Scottish government agreed this week to match the UK government's £10 million to create two defence technical excellence colleges.

facts.quote: And credit to Douglas and John Swinney for working together on that.
facts.statement: Douglas and John Swinney worked together on the defence technical excellence colleges funding.

facts.quote: It’s also why I am working on a new deal for food and farming at the EU-UK Summit on the 20th of November.
facts.statement: The Prime Minister is working on a new deal for food and farming for the EU-UK Summit on 20 November.

facts.quote: So in a couple of weeks, the National Economic Council will meet with the First Ministers of Scotland and Wales
facts.statement: The National Economic Council is due to meet with the First Ministers in a couple of weeks.

facts.quote: I was the MP there for sixteen years from the early 2000s
facts.statement: The Prime Minister was MP for Leigh for sixteen years from the early 2000s.

facts.quote: And I know that story myself, as well.
facts.statement: The Prime Minister represented Leigh, a former mining community in the old Lancashire coalfield.

facts.quote: I was in Scotland for the Opening Ceremony of the Commonwealth Games in the summer
facts.statement: The Prime Minister attended the Opening Ceremony of the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow in the summer.

facts.quote: Twenty-seven years on, you led the way on devolution here in Scotland with the creation of the Scottish Parliament.
facts.statement: Scotland created the Scottish Parliament as part of devolution.

facts.quote: When I was Mayor of Greater Manchester, I put buses back under public control
facts.statement: As Mayor of Greater Manchester, the Prime Minister put buses back under public control.

facts.quote: In my ten years as the mayor
facts.statement: The Prime Minister served ten years as Mayor of Greater Manchester.
